notes.ecology: Recovered from exact uncompressed Library source; direct static HTML; packed transport removed.
notes.scope: This manifest describes public release surfaces only. Private recovery/open-thread state is intentionally excluded.
notes.field_intake: Recovered from prior public release; runtime blobs preserved, service-worker cache cleanup narrowed to its own cache family.
notes.sleeper: Public experiment. Same canonical state is exposed as first-person coupled law field and plain obligation list; geometry is explicitly not external truth.
notes.scale_lens: RC11.2 remains the stable public head. G2 identity/RETURN is unchanged; optional spatial-donor-1 is projection-only. External smoke run 1 exposed mobile importer overflow; targeted importer-wrap patch fixed it and representative traversal passes at 390px + 1280px.
notes.triangle_bench: Nested Field / Proof experiment. EXPLOIT / EXPLORE / PROVE simplex compared against a plain two-control allocation; no showcase card.
notes.showcase_trace: PASS: external Chromium representative-interaction smoke on all nine showcase cards at 390px + 1280px, 18/18. GitHub Actions run 35372320053. Rerun after public runtime changes.
notes.capability_map: Root showcase now exposes a transfer-oriented reading of the same nine public cards. Transfer labels describe reusable mechanisms, not additional public artifacts or a claim that a monolithic agent already exists.
notes.routing: Nine public showcase artifacts now expose accepts/transforms/emits/evidence contracts. agent-router.json may compose or skip stages and selects the smallest adequate route under permission, reversibility and evidence constraints.
notes.execution_boundary: Showcase contracts are public semantic/reference interfaces only. Private personal traffic and credentials belong to private runtime adapters; no public showcase route is an implicit execution endpoint.
notes.router_bench: Deterministic public workbench over the live capability contracts and adapter declarations. It simulates routing/permission/RETURN only; private execution remains outside the public surface.
notes.human_return: 0 / HUMAN PORT 0.2 is now an actual transport-neutral instrument rather than a passive placeholder: PING/REPLY/NEED/CHECK produce a local 0P1 envelope for native sharing now; future private adapters must inherit the public promise contract and may not impersonate the user or fabricate live state.
notes.person_resource_policy: Deny-by-default seven-gate policy contract: READ, REMEMBER, ACKNOWLEDGE, ANSWER, DRAFT, ACT and ESCALATE. Public files contain schema/synthetic example only; real person/resource refs and policies belong to the private runtime.
notes.policy_inheritance: Deterministic broad-to-narrow policy composition: base -> person/resource in parallel -> channel. Restriction is automatic; widening requires user_explicit grant authority. Same-stage deny wins, allow sets intersect, deny sets union, ceilings choose the minimum, locks are inherited and cannot be widened.
notes.policy_selectors: Deterministic selector syntax for base/person/resource/channel policy matching. Exact > pattern > tag > fallback for trace/specificity; all matching non-fallback restrictions accumulate; fallback activates only when no non-fallback selector in that layer/domain matches; declaration order is never security-significant.
notes.policy_selector: Deterministic exact/pattern/tag/fallback selectors. Exact > pattern > tag > fallback is trace/fallback precedence only; every matching non-fallback policy composes, so broader denies and locks remain effective.
notes.policy_trace: Append-only causal trace spans selector clauses, matched policy revisions, inheritance, every operation, accepted/rejected grants, deny events, lock events, stage results, seven final gates and terminal resolution; raw payload/secrets stay out.
notes.forward_center_mass: Parallel control projection: 117 memory objects → 8 reusable operators → ≤3 active execution fronts → local RETURN receipts. Heuristic projection; does not rewrite federation canon.
notes.axial: Canonical AXIAL experiment remains /foundry/axial/ and is intentionally not a root showcase card. v0.4 adds an ancestry-linked before/gesture/after event ledger and schema; promotion still requires interpretable digital-trial and physical nested-tube receipts.
notes.forward_field_proof: FIELD / PROOF remains the public PROVE adapter for PLAIN-vs-rich representation, interruption recovery, constraint retention and opportunity noticing. Its general attention-control lessons are absorbed into FCM; its time/execution lessons route to Atlas Dayline rather than creating another planner runtime.
notes.now_projection: Root NOW filter highlights the current human-facing heads; FCM 0.2 owns NOW/NEXT/HOLD/DROP attention projection and common RETURN receipts. CURRENT.json remains the cold-start source of truth.
notes.reachability: All public directory index surfaces are reachable from the showcase graph; nested experiments stay reachable through their parent rather than receiving new cards.
notes.recovery_vault: Exact recovered donors are now visible through /recovery/ without becoming showcase cards or current heads. Source fidelity and blockers live in control/RECOVERY_RUN_2026-09-19.json.
notes.verse_atlas_replay: Recovered Grid Path Compiler RETURN→REPLAY closed a concrete head gap: Verse Atlas now validates and replays its own FOUNDRY/VERSE-ATLAS-1 JSON receipt. General donor workbench features remain frozen.
notes.fold_weave: Fold Weave 0.1 is an exact recovered sibling with persistent crease anchors / authored topology. It is linked from Fold/Bloom but is not promoted over Ecology pending direct playtest.
